title: 第一卷 第3章 不打无准备的仗，那就是蛮干，凭她爱道歉
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季望棉微微眯眸：“对方明确答应了？”

季大伯有些心虚地摇头：“那倒没有。”

对方觉得自己儿子是排长了，完全可以娶个高官的女儿，总比娶个乡下女人强，季大伯磨破了嘴皮子，才有这次见面的机会。

季望棉一眼就看出了他的心虚，气得有些磨牙。

还不确定就巴巴带着她跑来了！！

可能是季望棉的视线太凌厉，季大伯干脆摊手：“我也没办法，别说咱们村，附近的村都是歪瓜裂枣，哪个配得上你，那城里的眼睛都长到头顶上了去了，你去了能有好。

肖林术多好，都是乡下出身，他是排长不错，但是你长得好，还是高中学历，配他绰绰有余。”

季大伯说着说着，弯起的腰直了起来。

他没错！

说句遭雷劈的话，对方要是死了，貌美的年轻寡妇带着大笔抚恤金，在他们家旁边盖个房子。

想要多少小伙子就要多少，他还可以帮着遮掩，加上望军的权势。

不夸张地说，在北溪村横着走。

“那怎么办？直接告诉他找错人了，咱们现在回去？”

季大伯其实有些不舍得，捏着衣角，脚尖在地上戳戳：“我觉得这小伙子挺好的，长得好，身板也硬实。”

这身板，一枪怕是都打不穿。

“棉棉，我突然想起来了，家里还有点事，我就先走了，这是你的东西和你的介绍信，还有二十天过期，抓紧结婚，否则会被当盲流抓走的。”

没有他在，一个如花似玉的女人住在这里，一个萧临戍绝对可以拿下！

季大珠一咬牙，抬脚就往外走，刚到门口又转身回来，往她手里塞了一个东西。

“别怪大伯！”

像狗在后面追似的。

“大伯，你慢点跑，鞋掉了！”

季望棉捏了捏手中被报纸裹起来的东西。

里面应该是钱！

季望棉看着干瘦仓皇的背影，五味杂陈。

季望棉没有时间悲伤怀秋，她现在首要任务是拿下对方。

有脚步声靠近。

萧临戍回来的时候，就看见季望棉拿着扫把打扫院子。

简单的动作却让她做得那么美，土黄的灰尘四溅，却像是被她打了一层朦胧的纱幔。

肌肤莹白细腻，像上好的羊脂玉一般温润通透，不见半点粗糙暗沉。

听到了动静，微微转头。

眼瞳清亮似水，含着浅浅柔光，鼻型秀气玲珑，唇瓣色泽温润嫣红。

Page (1/3)

Ji Wangmian narrowed his eyes slightly: "The other party clearly agreed?"

Uncle Ji shook his head guiltily: "That's not true."

The other party felt that since his son was a platoon leader, he could marry the daughter of a high-ranking official, which was better than marrying a country woman. Uncle Ji had to talk a lot, so he had the opportunity to meet this time.

Ji Wangmian could see his guilty conscience at a glance, and he was so angry that he gritted his teeth.

Before she was sure, Baba came running with her!!

Perhaps Ji Wangmian's gaze was too sharp, so Uncle Ji simply spread his hands and said, "I can't help it. Not to mention our village, the nearby villages are all crooked melons and cracked jujubes. Which one is worthy of you? The eyes in the city have grown to the top of their heads. It will be better if you go there."

Xiao Lin is very good at martial arts. He was born in the countryside. He is a good platoon leader, but you are good-looking and have a high school education, which is more than enough for him."

As Uncle Ji spoke, his bent waist straightened up.

He is right!

To put it bluntly, if the other party dies, the beautiful young widow will take a large pension and build a house next to their house.

You can have as many young men as you want, and he can also help cover it up, plus Wang Jun's power.

It is no exaggeration to say that walking sideways in Beixi Village.

"Then what should we do? Tell him directly that he has found the wrong person. Let's go back now?"

Uncle Ji was actually a little reluctant. He pinched the corner of his clothes and poked the ground with his toes: "I think this young man is quite good. He looks good and has a strong body."

I'm afraid even a shot wouldn't be able to penetrate this body.

"Mianmian, I suddenly remembered. I have something to do at home, so I'll leave first. These are your things and your letter of introduction. They will expire in twenty days. Get married as soon as possible, otherwise you will be taken away as a blind drifter."

Without him, if a woman as beautiful as a flower lives here, Xiao Linshu can definitely take it down!

Ji Dazhu gritted his teeth and walked out. As soon as he reached the door, he turned back and stuffed something into her hand.

"Don't blame uncle!"

Like a dog chasing after you.

"Uncle, run slower, your shoe has fallen off!"

Ji Wangmian pinched something wrapped in newspaper in his hand.

There should be money in it!

Ji Wangmian looked at the thin and hurried back with mixed emotions.

Ji Wangmian has no time to grieve about Huaiqiu. Her first priority now is to win over the other party.

There were footsteps approaching.

When Xiao Linshu came back, he saw Ji Wangmian cleaning the yard with a broom.

The simple movement made her do it so beautifully. The earthy dust was scattered everywhere, but it seemed like she had covered it with a hazy gauze.

The skin is white and delicate, as moist and translucent as fine suet jade, without any roughness or dullness.

Hearing the movement, he turned his head slightly.

The eyes are as clear as water, with a soft light in their mouths, the nose is delicate and delicate, and the lips are warm and bright red.
